about: Text alternatives for the brand images, wherever a page shows them (the website's og:image:alt and ; neither store console takes alt text for listing images, so the listings' own text says what matters). make_art.py pick fills the icon's and the emblem's from the picked motif; the screenshots' come from their captions and what they show. docs/STORE_ART.md lists where each is used.
icon: Epic Audio Games app icon: a white speech bubble holding gold sound bars, on navy.
emblem: Epic Audio Games logo: a white speech bubble holding gold sound bars.
featureGraphic: Epic Audio Games: audio story games you play by voice. Golden rings of sound spreading out across a deep navy background.
og: Epic Audio Games: audio story games you play by voice.

screenshots.01_games: Story games you play by voice. The Games tab: a list of games, each with its cover, a Play button and a button to get more stories.
screenshots.02_story: Every word on screen, as it's spoken. A story playing, with each line in the transcript and the word being spoken highlighted.
screenshots.03_answer: Answer out loud, type or tap. The game listening for an answer, with the answer options as buttons and a box to type in.
screenshots.04_big_text: Big, clear text. High contrast. The game in the high-contrast theme at a large text size.
screenshots.05_voice_speed: Voice speed, your way. Settings, with the voice speed control and the sound settings.
screenshots.06_help: Help, read out loud. A help topic with its Listen button.
screenshots.07_shop: One-time packs. No ads. The Shop, with packs for each game and their prices.
screenshots.08_eight_games: Eight games, from werewolves to pirates. More of the games list.
screenshots.09_screen_reader: Works with the phone's screen reader. A game being played with the screen reader's focus on the talking circle.
